questions.prompt: A system has a good aggregate speech metric. What is still needed?
questions.explanation: Aggregate metrics can miss names, numbers, repetition and other task-critical errors.

questions.prompt: Why measure time to first playable audio separately from total generation time?
options: Only total duration affects a conversation
Callers experience the initial wait as well as playback continuity
questions.explanation: Streaming can start playback before synthesis finishes. Initial latency and sustained delivery are distinct.

questions.prompt: The voice sounds natural but reads 15 as 50. How should you classify it?
options: A pass because naturalness is high
questions.explanation: Naturalness does not compensate for speaking the wrong information.
